products.title: Products
products.archiveHint: The product leaves the list and the product pickers. You can restore it from the archived products.
products.restoreHint: The product returns to the list and the product pickers.

tax.label: {name} ({rate}%)
tax.several: This product carries more than one tax. Pick one to replace them all, or leave them as they are.

managed.title: View only
managed.managed_in_root_company: This product is managed from the main company. Switch to a main company session to change it.
managed.managed_in_branch: This product is managed from another branch. Switch to that branch's session to change it.

form.definitionHint: The name, type, price, tax and what your team sees when choosing the product.
form.name: Name
form.priceHint: Enter the price as you want it written on the product.
form.priceNeedsRight: Changing the price needs the "Manage prices" permission.
form.priceOnly: You can change the price only. The rest is view only.
form.saveError: The product could not be saved

image.label: Image
image.hint: A JPEG or PNG image of at most {size} MB.
image.stored: The product has a saved image
image.willRemove: The image will be removed when you save
image.badType: Choose a JPEG or PNG image
image.tooLarge: The image is larger than {size} MB
image.unreadable: The file could not be read. Choose the image again.

errors.name: The product name is not valid
errors.type: The product type is not valid
errors.image: The system did not accept this image. Make sure it really is a JPEG or PNG
errors.taxes: The system did not accept this tax

settings.readOnly: Product settings belong to the managers of the main company. You can see them but cannot change them from here.

sharing.title: Product sharing
sharing.hint: Does each branch manage its own products, or does the whole establishment share them?
sharing.branchHint: Each new product belongs to the branch that created it, and only that branch's staff change it.
sharing.establishmentHint: Each new product is shared by all branches and managed from the main company.
sharing.shareTitle: Before choosing "Products of the whole establishment"
sharing.shareRoot: A shared product is created, edited and archived only from a main company session.
sharing.shareBranch: Every branch's staff see and use a shared product, but cannot change it.
sharing.transferRequired: Sharing cannot change once products exist. Moving products between the two modes comes in a later release, and the current value stays.
